prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a parking lot collision. The patient had 15 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1264; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of right shoulder pain and restricted range of motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the forces typically associated with a collision of this type. Over the course of 15 visits, the patient received conservative care including manual therapy, graduated strengthening exercises, and home exercise instruction. Course of treatment extended somewhat beyond what is typical for an injury of this nature, largely due to gradual progress in restoring motion. On examination, there was tenderness over the rotator cuff insertion and a positive impingement sign, findings that support the reported injury. Other testing, including neurological screening and strength assessment of the upper extremity, returned normal results. No prior injury or treatment involving the same shoulder region is documented in the available history. Billing records reviewed for this episode show no duplicate or repeated charges for services.
